issue_policy.new_findings: Add a named failing reproduction and semantic expected answer in the same corrective candidate; preserve it after the fix.
issue_policy.release: All named owner tests must execute successfully. Open Core qualifications block release; inventory membership never means product or native acceptance.
issue_policy.truth: Assert actual identity, effects, storage and evidence boundaries; no exact wording-only or metadata-only acceptance.
